text:
The ticket says to shut leaf1:eth1 and spine1:eth1, but the diff only adds `shutdown` under the interface with description "server web-a1" (access vlan 110, the server-facing port), not the uplink. The diff therefore appears to take down web-a1's access port rather than the spine link. I wrote tests that verify the ticket's intent (adjacency down, redundancy, no reachability loss) and that also catch the diff's actual effect (web-a1 isolation).

```json
{"tests":[
{"t":"adj","a":"leaf1","b":"spine1","expect":"down"},
{"t":"adj","a":"leaf1","b":"spine2","expect":"up"},
{"t":"adj","a":"leaf2","b":"spine1","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"adj","a":"leaf3","b":"spine1","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"adj","a":"border1","b":"spine1","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"path","src":"web-a1","dst":"db-a1","via":"spine1","expect":false},
{"t":"path","src":"web-a1","dst":"db-a1","via":"spine2","expect":true},
{"t":"reach","src":"web-a1","dst":"app-a1","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"web-a1","dst":"dns-dc1","svc":"udp/53","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"web-a1","dst":"db-a1","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"web-a1","dst":"wan-user1","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"wan-user1","dst":"web-a1","svc":"tcp/443","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"wan-user1","dst":"web-a1","svc":"tcp/80","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noc1","dst":"web-a1","svc":"icmp","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"stage-a1","dst":"web-a1","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"app-a1","dst":"db-a1","svc":"tcp/5432","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"web-b1","dst":"dns-dc1","svc":"udp/53","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"db-a1","dst":"backup1","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"leaf1","dst":"spine2","svc":"icmp","expect":"allow"},
{"t":"route","dev":"leaf1","prefix":"10.101.1.0/24","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"route","dev":"spine1","prefix":"10.101.1.0/24","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"route","dev":"leaf1","prefix":"10.103.1.0/24","expect":"present"},
{"t":"route","dev":"leaf1","prefix":"10.30.0.0/24","expect":"present"},
{"t":"conv","a":"leaf1","b":"spine1","max_s":3},
{"t":"load","a":"leaf1","b":"spine2","max_pct":90},
{"t":"load","a":"spine2","b":"border1","max_pct":90},
{"t":"mtu","src":"web-a1","dst":"app-a1","size":9000,"expect":"pass"}
]}
```

Several of these tests (the web-a1 reachability checks and the `route` check for 10.101.1.0/24 on leaf1) will fail if the diff is applied as written, which is intended: they flag that the diff does not match the ticket. The change should be corrected to shut down the actual uplink interfaces (leaf1:eth1 and spine1:eth1) before approval.
